transition: Event.dispose: disposed := true; begin is refused afterwards (ThrowIfDisposed)
Event.dispose starts ShutdownAsync once; its TryComplete and CancelAsync are Event.complete and Event.shutdownCancel
Event.arm: armed := true; cancelBeforeClaim runs at once when the caller's token is already cancelled
Event.dequeue: claim unclaimed -> claimed and the writer runs the job; any other claim -> skip
cancelBeforeClaim (Event.arm, Event.cancel): claim unclaimed -> cancelledBeforeClaim, outcome pending -> canceled
